text:
claire: Quick sync idea — we should try a credit-aware routing mode that prefers cheaper model variants for Starter/Free customers once their token burn rate exceeds a threshold. thinking about API flags + console rollout UX.
ajay: doable but warning: streaming + partial-charges complicate per-request token accounting. we need a reliable "token_velocity" signal aggregated at request start.
anika: +1. also need a policy DSL extension. rough draft:
```
policy:
  match: tenant.tier in ["starter","free"]
  strategy: prefer_cheapest_with_quality_guard
  params:
    token_velocity_limit: 60  # tokens/min
    quality_delta_threshold: 0.03
    fallback_variant: variant-light
```
mario: what telemetry do we surface for PM/ops? I want to see cost delta, % of calls served by cheap variant, and quick regressions by eval-set slices.
claire: exactly — console should show predicted unit-cost change before enabling and then a realtime chart: cheap-hit-rate, tokens_saved, quality_regressions, rollback_reasons.
ajay: implementation note: cheap variant selection must be consistent across multi-chunk streams otherwise hallucination/consistency problems. if we switch mid-stream we should either pin the variant or revert whole request.
anika: agreed. UI rollout controls: canary by tenant sample, by region, by route. add an explicit "budget-protection" toggle that enforces a hard token cap per-minute per-tenant.
claire: API shape idea — accept headers/route policy that hint budget caps. e.g.
```
curl -X POST /v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." \ 
  -H "X-Tenant-Budget-Cap: 50" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat","prompt":"..."}'
```
ajay: header is fine but runtime should ignore client-sent caps unless tenant has opt-in. otherwise abusive clients dodge billing.
mario: product question — when to surface fallbacks to customers? show a small footer: "This response used a lower-cost variant to reduce charges"? or keep transparent only in bill breakdown?
claire: recommend optional transparency in response (opt-in) + always surface in billing console. ops may want immediate alert if auto-fallback rate spikes.
ops-bot: experiment created: credit-aware-routing/stage1 by @claire — sampling 3% of starter tenants in us-east.
devex-bot: deploy: routing-policy-service v0.43 -> staging (config credit-aware feature flag enabled)
ajay: next steps for runtime: (1) add token_velocity meter + prefix cache awareness, (2) variant-pinning for streams, (3) per-tenant soft throttle + hard cap enforcement, (4) metric tags: cheap_variant, fallback_reason.
anika: UI tasks: create console preview modal (predicted monthly savings + quality risk), rollout controls (canary %, region, tenant segment), and a logs-explorer filter for fallback incidents.
mario: add automatic regression watch: run eval-set slices every hour for affected tenants; trigger rollback if metric breach for 2 consecutive windows.
claire: action items: @ajay draft runtime design doc by EOD Tue; @anika prototype console preview by Thu; @mario define eval slices + SLOs. I'll schedule a 30m sync after docs.
ajay: noted. starting a staging branch and will post link.
claire: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
